_doc: Emerald-only story objects of the Magma Hideout (emerald_ch8_hideout 2026-10-12; generated by work/agents/emerald_ch8_hideout/tools/mk_story_json.py from pokeemerald's eight Magma Hideout maps): the 16 grunts and Tabitha as eye-contact trainers, Maxie and the two Groudon objects of 4F (scene: src/field_scripts/emerald/0718_room_MagmaHideout_4F.s). Zone tiles = pokeemerald tiles (the rooms' origin is 0,0), "zone" = the room's zone (data/emerald/hoenn_interiors.json).
